name: Question 10
problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{4}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{4}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=3x$ for $x\in [-4,4).$ The Fourier series of the $8$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${b}_{5}.$

${b}_{5}=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the sine coefficients are given by

$$
{b}_{n}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{L}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=4$ and $f(x)=3x$ for $x\in (-4,4).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
{b}_{5}=\frac{1}{4}{\int }_{-4}^{4}3x\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

We use the integration by parts: 

$$
\begin{aligned}u=3x\, & ⇒\,{u}^{′}=3 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)\, & ⇒\,v=-\frac{4}{5\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}_{5} & =\frac{1}{4}(uv\,{|}_{-4}^{4}-{\int }_{-4}^{4}v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}(-\frac{4}{5\pi }{[3x\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)]}_{-4}^{4}+\frac{12}{5\pi }{\int }_{-4}^{4}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{5\pi }(-{[3x\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)]}_{-4}^{4}+3{\int }_{-4}^{4}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{5\pi }(-((3(4))\operatorname{cos}⁡(5\pi )-(3(-4))\operatorname{cos}⁡(-5\pi ))+\frac{12}{5\pi }{[\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{4}x)]}_{-4}^{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{5\pi }(24+\frac{12}{5\pi }(\operatorname{sin}⁡(5\pi )-\operatorname{sin}⁡(-5\pi ))) \\  & =\frac{1}{5\pi }\cdot 24 \\  & =\frac{24}{5\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

For the Fourier series of a 2L-periodic function, the sine coefficients are given by bn=1L∫−LLf(x)sin⁡(nπLx)dx.

In our case, L=4 and f(x)=3x for x∈(−4,4). So, substituting into the formula, we get b5=14∫−443xsin⁡(5π4x)dx.

We use the integration by parts: u=3x⇒u′=3v′=sin⁡(5π4x)⇒v=−45πcos⁡(5π4x)

Thus, we obtain b5=14(uv|−44−∫−44vu′dx)=14(−45π[3xcos⁡(5π4x)]−44+125π∫−44cos⁡(5π4x)dx)=15π(−[3xcos⁡(5π4x)]−44+3∫−44cos⁡(5π4x)dx)=15π(−((3(4))cos⁡(5π)−(3(−4))cos⁡(−5π))+125π[sin⁡(5π4x)]−44)=15π(24+125π(sin⁡(5π)−sin⁡(−5π)))=15π⋅24=245π.
